title: server.selftest (server → platform, reliable)
description: The core's selftest outcome changed (pass/fail, the counts or the failing checks): the automatic selftest 15 s after the first map, `ru selftest`, or the status endpoint's `/selftest?run=1`. Same object as hello.selftest, which carries the latest outcome on every connect. A re-run with the same outcome is not sent. Proposed here, FLEET.md §6.1, §8.1.
